hooks.name: No real data
hooks.description: After Kiro edits fixtures, samples, tests, or mocks, scan for real-looking personal data or brands and replace them.

action.prompt:
No real data hook. Apply ONLY if the file you just edited is under backend/synthetic/, backend/samples/, backend/tests/, or backend/app/mocks/. Otherwise ignore this hook.

Scan the edited file for:
- Real-looking SSNs matching ###-##-#### (allowed only if clearly synthetic, e.g. starting with 000 or 9xx).
- Real-looking street addresses.
- Real brand or employer names (e.g. real gig apps, restaurants, banks). Allowed synthetic names: QuickDash, Harbor Cafe, Ramos Family Bakery, Eastside Community Food Pantry.
Replace any match with a synthetic value and keep tests and ground truth consistent. Then warn me with a list of what you found and what you replaced it with.
